# pve-rclone-backup storage

Manage offsite (rclone-backup) storages.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`init`](#storage-init) | Create the repository, export its recovery kit and add the storage to PVE |
| [`list`](#storage-list) | List offsite storages |
| [`resync`](#storage-resync) | Rebuild the catalogue from the remote |
| [`set`](#storage-set) | Change storage properties (through the PVE API) |
| [`show`](#storage-show) | Show an offsite storage |

## storage init

Create (or adopt) the offsite repository for a new storage, export and confirm its recovery
kit, then add the storage to /etc/pve/storage.cfg through the PVE API.

The recovery kit holds the encryption keys. Without it, encrypted backups cannot be restored
after the loss of this host; replication only starts once the kit is confirmed.

With --read-only, an existing repository is bound to browse and restore the backups of another
installation (its --source): the storage replicates nothing and is immutable, so nothing in it can be
deleted or pruned.

```
pve-rclone-backup storage init <storage> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--adopt-source` | take over a source name registered by another installation (disaster recovery) |
| `--confirm-checksum string` | confirm the kit non-interactively with its checksum |
| `--encryption string` | crypt or none (default `crypt`) |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing kit file |
| `--include-token` | include the remote's credentials (OAuth token) in the kit |
| `--kit-file string` | where to write the recovery kit (default &lt;storage&gt;-recovery-kit.txt) |
| `--kit-passphrase-file string` | encrypt the kit with the passphrase in this file |
| `--no-pvesh` | print the pvesh command instead of running it |
| `--path string` | repository path inside the remote (default `pve-backups`) |
| `--read-only` | only browse and restore an existing repository's backups of --source |
| `--remote string` | transport remote (see 'remote list') |
| `--replicate-from strings` | local backup storages to replicate (comma separated) |
| `--source string` | name of this installation inside the repository (e.g. the cluster name) |

## storage list

List offsite storages.

```
pve-rclone-backup storage list
```

## storage resync

Rebuild the catalogue from the remote.

```
pve-rclone-backup storage resync <storage>
```

## storage set

Change storage properties (through the PVE API).

```
pve-rclone-backup storage set <storage> <property>=<value>...
```

## storage show

Show an offsite storage.

```
pve-rclone-backup storage show <storage>
```

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
